**Not ready to publish.** One claim is unsupported.

## Claims check

| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| "The UK's number one tea subscription" | **Unsupported.** It is a superlative we can't prove, and the policy bans "number one" and "the UK's favourite". |
| "Subscribers can pause or cancel any time." | Allowlisted (subscription terms). |
| "Free UK delivery on orders over £25." | Allowlisted (shipping policy). |
| "Tea Subscription UK" (headline) | No claim. |

## Suggested fix

Remove the superlative and replace it with something from the product facts:

- **Headline:** Tea Subscription UK
- **Description:** Loose leaf and plastic-free tea bags, delivered monthly. Subscribers can pause or cancel any time. Free UK delivery on orders over £25.

The replacement uses only allowlisted claims and product facts. You gave no character limit, so I haven't counted. Check it against the platform's description limit (Google RSA descriptions allow 90 characters). If it runs over, drop the first sentence.

## Before it goes out

- The landing page must also make the pause/cancel and free-delivery claims, and I can't check that from here.
- Sam needs to approve it, since all public content goes through them.

```json
{"issues": [{"quote": "The UK's number one tea subscription.", "type": "superlative"}], "publish": false}
```
